name: B200 (Blackwell, HGX)
notes: Per the official NVIDIA Blackwell architecture datasheet's footnote 1, all Tensor Core figures in the source table except FP64 are shown as sparse-only (no dense value independently published) -- dense fields left null rather than derived/halved. FP8 and FP6 Tensor Core published as a single combined figure (shared tensor core datapath) -- both fields carry the same source value. Memory listed as 180GB HBM3e in this official datasheet; some earlier NVIDIA marketing materials cited 192GB as the physical HBM3e stack size before reserved capacity -- 180GB is the software-visible, spec-sheet figure used here. cooling_type set to 'air' per this datasheet's HGX B200 real-time inference chart footnote describing 'air-cooled' HGX B200 configurations; liquid-cooled HGX B200 deployments also exist at rack density per third-party sources, so treat as the documented baseline rather than the only option.

_sources.fp32_tflops: https://www.primeline-solutions.com/media/categories/server/nach-gpu/nvidia-hgx-h200/nvidia-blackwell-b200-datasheet.pdf (p.7, Technical Specifications table) -- cross-checked against a separate NVIDIA HGX B200 PCF Summary document, which lists a total (8-GPU) figure of 'FP32 600 PFLOPS'; 75 TFLOPS/GPU x 8 = 600 TFLOPS, confirming that PCF document's unit label is a typo (should read TFLOPS, not PFLOPS) rather than a data discrepancy.
